# Synthetic audit fixture: SSO/IAM Identity Center profile names (SPEC §27)
# in the aws-prefixed label spellings. Profile names are short arbitrary
# strings, so prose safety lives in the VALUE anchor, not the label: the
# value must carry a dash, underscore or digit plus a minimum run — every
# real SSO profile name has one (`corp-admin-prod`,
# `PowerUserAccess-123456789012`), while `default`, `EXAMPLE`, the
# `<profile>` placeholder and prose never do. The bare `profile` label is
# deliberately NOT matched: Terraform/HCL documentation writes
# `profile = "some-profile"` as an ordinary key. Synthetic values.
export AWS_PROFILE=corp-admin-prod
aws_profile = "corp-admin-prod"
"AwsProfile": "PowerUserAccess-123456789012"
$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'corp_admin_prod'
AWS PROFILE = CorpAdmin-Prod2
awsProfile=dev_profile
# Generic, placeholder and prose forms that must stay silent.
AWS_PROFILE=default
export AWS_PROFILE=<profile>
# The AWS profile is selected externally after SSO login.
